mapper.sql: id, ticket_category_id, redis_available_stock, mysql_available_stock, mysql_locked_stock, mysql_sold_stock, in_flight_deducted_quantity, expected_redis_available_stock, diff, status, check_type, repair_strategy, repair_result, created_at, updated_at, repaired_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock_consistency_record ( ticket_category_id, redis_available_stock, mysql_available_stock, mysql_locked_stock, mysql_sold_stock, in_flight_deducted_quantity, expected_redis_available_stock, diff, status, check_type, repair_strategy, repair_result, created_at, updated_at, repaired_at ) VALUES ( #{ticketCategoryId}, #{redisAvailableStock}, #{mysqlAvailableStock}, #{mysqlLockedStock}, #{mysqlSoldStock}, #{inFlightDeductedQuantity}, #{expectedRedisAvailableStock}, #{diff}, #{status}, #{checkType}, #{repairStrategy}, #{repairResult}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{repairedAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE stock_consistency_record SET status = 'REPAIRED', repair_strategy = #{repairStrategy}, repair_result = #{repairResult}, repaired_at = #{repairedAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED')
UPDATE stock_consistency_record SET status = 'FAILED', repair_strategy = #{repairStrategy}, repair_result = #{repairResult}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED')
UPDATE stock_consistency_record SET status = 'IGNORED', repair_result = #{repairResult}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED')
